nodes.name: Lemma 3.1: tabular c Hausdorff metric finite time tabular
nodes.statement:
Fix $T \in (0,\infty)$. 
The family $(\mathbf{P}^{\kappa}_{\!T})_{\kappa > 0}$ of laws of the $\operatorname{SLE}_{\kappa}$ curves viewed as probability measures on 
$(\mathfrak{X}_{T},d_{\mathfrak{C}})$ 
satisfy an LDP with good rate function $I_{T}$.

Theorem 1.2: tabular c Full parameterized curves tabular
nodes.statement:
The family $(\mathbf{P}^{\kappa}_{\!\!D;x,y})_{\kappa > 0}$ of laws of the $\operatorname{SLE}_{\kappa}$ curves 
satisfy an LDP on $(\mathfrak{X}_{}(D;x,y),d_{\mathfrak{X}_{}})$ 
with good rate function $I_{D;x,y}$ defined by~(1.3).
